Final Business Insights and Recommendations¶

Key Business Insights¶

  1. Social Media campaigns show relatively high engagement scores across marketing channels.
  2. Conversion rates are broadly similar across different marketing channels.
  3. Engagement Score and Conversion Rate have a very weak correlation (0.01).
  4. ROI contributions are relatively balanced across the ten locations.
  5. Marketing campaign performance varies across customer segments and target audiences.
  6. Acquisition Cost and ROI show a declining pattern in the scatter plot.

Business Recommendations¶

  1. Continue investing in Social Media campaigns while monitoring conversion performance.
  2. Evaluate campaigns using ROI and conversion rate rather than engagement alone.
  3. Identify high-performing customer segments and develop targeted campaigns.
  4. Compare acquisition costs across locations to improve marketing budget allocation.
  5. Regularly monitor campaign performance and optimize underperforming campaigns.

Conclusion¶

The analysis provides insights into marketing campaign performance across companies, channels, locations, languages, and customer segments. Businesses can use these findings to improve campaign targeting, optimize marketing expenditure, and support data-driven decisions.
